# AetherForge
Hardware-aware safety and control plane for local AI agents on consumer GPUs.

## Current State (Wedge A)
The system is a FastAPI control plane that sits between autonomous agents and local inference engines. 
Default engine is a Mock Engine for CI/CD and CPU-only environments. Real hardware engines (Llama/KTransformers) are experimental (Wedge B).

## Core Architecture
1. Agent -> FastAPI Control Plane (`src/server.py`)
2. Economic Gatekeeper (`src/server.py:EconomicGatekeeper`) - Calculates ROI of VRAM strategy swaps based on latency/TPS.
3. Hardware Watchdog (`src/server.py:hardware_watchdog`) - Async background task monitoring thermals/VRAM.
4. Hardware Monitor (`src/hardware_monitor.py`) - Reads NVML or falls back to simulated chaos state.
5. Engine Factory (`src/engines/__init__.py`) - Lazy-loads inference engines to prevent CUDA crashes on boot.

## Key API Endpoints
- POST `/generate`: Main inference route. Enforces 503 (thermal/queue lock) and 413 (context ceiling).
- POST `/system/strategy`: Agent requests VRAM allocation changes. Gatekeeper evaluates ROI.
- GET `/system/metrics`: Exposes silicon vitals and thermal lock status.
- GET `/system/tools`: Returns OpenAI-compatible function calling schema for agent discovery.

## Development Rules
- Never import heavy inference libraries globally. Use lazy loading.
- Never use `print()`. Use `src.logger.get_logger('namespace')`.
- All hardware interactions must go through `HardwareMonitor`.
- Mock engine is the default for all tests and CI.
